get_project_summary: Read the project health, task counts, and launch context from page-local state.
search_tasks: Search or resolve tasks already loaded in this page by title, owner, priority, or status. Use the returned matches to identify an exact task before changing its status.
get_current_user: Read the signed-in user and permissions from the local session state.
set_task_status: Update a task status in the page-local workspace and return the updated task.
